answer: Clawback vesting at the prism: payouts release over 90 days, each epoch's reward split into locked tranches. A bond slashes retroactively if any tranche traces to a sybil cluster. Umber marks the risk surface — attacker must float 90 days of operating cost across every identity before knowing which survive. To forge ten identities costs ~10x upfront capital plus total loss on exposure. Honest nodes pay only time preference. Works because sybil cost scales linearly with identity count while attacker revenue stays flat during vesting.
